seo.description: Holistic dentistry in Valencia, CA: mercury-free fillings, SMART amalgam removal, fluoride-free cleanings and ozone therapy with Dr. Neda Moezzi.

hero.lead: Dr. Neda Moezzi practices biological dentistry in Santa Clarita: biocompatible materials, minimally invasive treatment and care that respects the link between your mouth and the rest of your body.
hero.imageAlt: Dr. Neda Moezzi, DDS, in her Valencia office

intro.heading: Dental care that considers the whole body
paragraphs: Your mouth is not separate from the rest of you. Gum inflammation, infection and the materials placed in your teeth can all have effects beyond your smile. Holistic dentistry at Valencia Smile Expert starts from that idea. Dr. Moezzi chooses biocompatible, mercury-free materials, favors prevention over intervention and avoids procedures you do not need. The aim is a healthy mouth that supports a healthy body.

This approach suits people managing a chronic condition, people who want to limit their exposure to metals and additives, and anyone who simply prefers a more thoughtful, less aggressive style of dental care. From tooth-colored fillings made without mercury or BPA to fluoride-free cleanings and gentle gum therapy, every treatment is chosen with your body, your history and your preferences in mind.

whoItsFor.heading: Who it's for
whoItsFor.intro: Holistic care is for anyone who wants a safer, more natural approach to their teeth, and it fits especially well if you recognize yourself below.
items: You prefer metal-free, mercury-free and fluoride-free treatment options
You live with a chronic illness or autoimmune condition and want your dental care to account for it
You have had allergic or sensitivity reactions to dental materials in the past
You want old silver fillings removed with safety protocols in place
You are looking for gentle, minimally invasive care for your family

benefits.heading: Benefits of holistic dental care
benefits.intro: Holistic dentistry offers more than a healthy smile; it reduces what your body has to deal with and keeps the focus on long-term wellness.

items.title: Less exposure to mercury and fluoride
items.text: Materials and preventive products are chosen to avoid substances many patients prefer to keep out of their bodies.

items.title: Prevention first
items.text: Regular, gentle care aimed at keeping teeth and gums healthy so that fewer repairs are ever needed.

items.title: Works with your body
items.text: Treatments are chosen to support your natural healing rather than work against it.

items.title: Thoughtful care for chronic and autoimmune conditions
items.text: A careful choice of materials and techniques for patients whose health already asks a lot of them.

items.title: Fewer material reactions
items.text: Metal-free, BPA-free restorations lower the chance of allergic or sensitivity reactions.

items.title: Whole-body support
items.text: Minimally invasive care and natural therapies that consider the whole person, not just the tooth.

options.heading: Our holistic treatments
options.intro: Each treatment uses safe materials and gentle technique, chosen to fit your body and your health goals.

items.title: Biocompatible fillings
items.text: Tooth-colored restorations made without mercury or BPA.

items.title: Safe amalgam removal
items.text: SMART-protocol removal of old silver fillings, with safeguards to limit mercury exposure during the procedure.

items.title: Ozone therapy
items.text: A natural antibacterial treatment used to support healing and reduce infection.

items.title: Fluoride-free cleanings
items.text: Gentle preventive care using alternative remineralizing agents.

items.title: Non-metal restorations
items.text: Durable, natural-looking crowns and bridges made without metal.

items.title: Holistic periodontal therapy
items.text: Gum care focused on reducing inflammation, which matters for the rest of the body too.

items.title: Holistic bone and gum grafting
items.text: Regenerative options such as PRF from your own blood and your own bone, with no synthetic additives.

process.heading: What to expect
process.intro: Your care follows three steps, each designed to keep your overall health in view.

steps.title: Comprehensive evaluation
steps.text: A full oral exam and a review of your medical history. When it is helpful, biocompatibility testing identifies which materials are the safest fit for your body.

steps.title: Personalized treatment plan
steps.text: Dr. Moezzi designs a plan around your wellness goals, prioritizing non-toxic materials, gentle technique and natural therapies, and explains each recommendation.

steps.title: Long-term care and prevention
steps.text: Ongoing preventive visits, education and natural maintenance strategies that fit your lifestyle, so good health is maintained rather than repaired.

technology.heading: Technology that supports gentle care
technology.intro: Precise tools let us treat conservatively and see problems early.

items.title: Digital X-rays and 3D CBCT imaging
items.text: Detailed images with less radiation than film, so small problems are found before they need bigger fixes.

items.title: Laser dentistry
items.text: Laser treatment for gum tissue can mean less bleeding and a gentler experience than traditional methods.

items.title: PRF therapy
items.text: Platelet-rich fibrin from your own blood supports healing after grafting and surgery with nothing synthetic added.

items.title: Intraoral cameras
items.text: You see what Dr. Moezzi sees, which makes conservative decisions easier to understand and agree on.

cost.heading: Cost and financing
cost.text: Many holistic treatments, such as tooth-colored fillings and cleanings, are covered by most major PPO plans in the same way as conventional care. We accept plans including Delta Dental, MetLife, Cigna and Aetna. Biocompatibility testing and some natural therapies may not be covered. Before any treatment starts, you receive a written estimate that shows what your plan is expected to pay and what you would owe. Flexible financing is available for larger plans. If you are new to the practice, the $59 new patient exam and X-rays is an easy first step.

faqs.q: What makes holistic dentistry different from traditional dentistry?
faqs.a: Holistic dentistry treats the mouth as part of the whole body. In practice that means biocompatible, mercury-free materials, fluoride-free options for those who prefer them, and a lean toward prevention and minimally invasive technique. The clinical skills are the same; the philosophy about materials and when to intervene is different.

faqs.q: Is holistic dentistry safe for kids and families?
faqs.a: Yes. Holistic care suits children and families who want gentle treatment without exposure to materials they would rather avoid. We offer fluoride-free preventive options and tooth-colored fillings made without mercury or BPA. Dr. Moezzi takes time with younger patients so visits feel calm rather than rushed.

SMART stands for Safe Mercury Amalgam Removal Technique, a protocol developed by the IAOMT, the International Academy of Oral Medicine and Toxicology. It sets out steps such as isolation, high-volume suction and protective barriers that reduce mercury exposure while old silver fillings are removed. Our team follows these guidelines when taking out amalgam.

Most holistic dentists, including Dr. Moezzi, offer fluoride-free alternatives. These use other remineralizing agents to help strengthen enamel without synthetic additives. If you have questions about fluoride for yourself or your children, raise them at your visit. The choice stays with you.

faqs.q: Can holistic dental care help with chronic health issues?
faqs.a: Holistic dentistry does not treat medical conditions, and we do not claim that it does. What it can do is reduce the load on your body by avoiding reactive materials and keeping gum inflammation under control. Many patients with autoimmune conditions, allergies or sensitivities find that this approach fits well with how they manage their health.

faqs.q: Are the materials used really that different?
faqs.a: Yes. We avoid metals, BPA and other substances that can provoke reactions, and every material is chosen for its compatibility with your body. Where it helps, biocompatibility testing can show which options are the best fit for you. You will always know what is going into your mouth and why.

cta.heading: Meet a holistic dentist in Valencia
cta.text: Bring your questions, your history and your preferences. Dr. Moezzi listens first and plans second. Patients visit us from Santa Clarita, Stevenson Ranch, Newhall, Saugus and Canyon Country.
